description: Knowledge about robots, automation systems, sensors, control systems, and intelligent machines.

topics.name: Robotics Fundamentals
knowledge: Robotics is the field of designing, building, and programming machines that perform tasks automatically.
A robot combines mechanical parts, electronics, software, and control systems.
Robots can perform tasks that are repetitive, dangerous, or require high precision.

topics.name: Robot Components
knowledge: Sensors allow robots to detect and measure information from their environment.
Actuators create movement by converting energy into motion.
Controllers process information and decide robot actions.
Processors run the software that controls robotic systems.

topics.name: Automation
knowledge: Automation uses technology to perform tasks with reduced human intervention.
Industrial automation improves speed, accuracy, and efficiency.
Software automation can control digital tasks and workflows.

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence in Robotics
knowledge: AI allows robots to understand environments and make decisions.
Machine learning helps robots improve from data and experience.
Computer vision enables robots to analyze images and objects.

topics.name: Control Systems
knowledge: Control systems manage how machines respond to inputs.
Feedback systems allow robots to adjust their actions.
Precise control is important for movement and stability.

topics.name: Future Robotics
knowledge: Future robots may assist in healthcare, manufacturing, exploration, and daily life.
Robotics combines engineering, programming, artificial intelligence, and science.
Responsible development ensures robots are safe and useful.
